description: Uploads a local audio file (path, or base64 content) and starts its separation into vocals + instrumental (stems=2) or vocals + drums + bass + other (stems=4) (POST /stem-tool/jobs). Asynchronous and slow (minutes, up to hours for a long file): by default this returns at once with the job, then follow it with jj_stems_get_job and fetch the files with jj_stems_get_file; pass maxWaitMs to wait for a short file instead. Needs the stems:write scope and an API key from a Premium account (403 otherwise). Limits on Premium: a file of at most 1 h 30 and under 2 GB (5 minutes and 100 MB without Premium). Quotas, in UTC days and calendar months, with one pair of counters per model: "fast" 10 jobs/day and 100/month (10800 s of audio/day, 54000 s/month), "quality" 2 jobs/day and 10/month (5400 s/day, 18000 s/month). Only one separation can run at a time per account. A 429 states when the counter resets; a 413 means the file is too large or too long. Stems come as MP3 320 kb/s by default, or as FLAC 24-bit with format="flac" (lossless, about 4 times larger). Check jj_stems_capabilities first.

contentBase64.description: Base64-encoded audio content. Mutually exclusive with path. Requires "filename".

filename.description: File name (with extension). Required with contentBase64; defaults to the basename of "path".

format.description: "mp3" (default, 320 kb/s) or "flac" (24-bit lossless, for mixing or mastering).

maxWaitMs.description: Wait up to this long (milliseconds, cap 600000) for the separation to finish. Default 0: return at once. Waiting needs a key with convert:read, otherwise the job is returned at once. The job keeps running if it is exceeded.

path.description: Absolute or relative local path to the audio file. Mutually exclusive with contentBase64.

stems.description: 2 = vocals + instrumental (default); 4 = vocals + drums + bass + other.

name: jj_stems_separate
title: Separate a song into stems
